items.source:
The count of the given expectation is incremented, then it is
either stored if remainingCount > 0 or removed otherwise.
items.translation: 给定期望的计数被递增，然后如果 remainingCount > 0 则将其存储，否则将其移除。

items.source: Return a matching expectation, or null if none match.
items.translation: 返回匹配的期望，如果没有匹配则返回null。

items.source: Reset all expectations for this group.
Helper class to manage a group of remaining expectations.
items.translation: 用于管理一组剩余期望的辅助类。

items.source: Invoke this for an expectation that has been matched.
items.translation: 为此已匹配的期望调用此方法。
